348:t_009:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The farce is over. ...I only came to get a look at your face, but I've changed my mind.」

348:t_009:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll give you three minutes of my time!」

348:t_009:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Fine by me, $$バルビエル$$. I owe you a lot.」

348:t_009:3.en:
$n
「I'll finish it in those three minutes...!」

348:t_009:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come on, $$いがみ合う双子$$...! I'll drown you in the sea of your own hatred!」

348:t_010:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... I'm finishing you off here!」

348:t_011:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Too slow, you waste of space!」

348:t_012:0.en:
$n
「He covered that distance in an instant...!」

348:t_012:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Once I enter the Third Stage, a trick like this is easy.」

348:t_012:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$F. Expecting anything from you was a mistake in the first place.」

348:t_012:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If it means handing your $$スフィア$$ over to him, I'd rather reset everything here, once!」

348:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Ha ha ha! Go curse your own fate!」

348:t_014:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We'll talk about that later, $$クロウ$$. Here and now, we take down the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$.」

348:t_014:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I followed him all the way to Mars, but it turned out to be an unexpected catch.」

348:t_014:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then let us call the one you're really after, too.」

348:t_015:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't worry. His target right now is the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$.」

348:t_015:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So my $$スフィア$$ and $n's are on hold for the time being.」

348:t_015:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...If you want to laugh, go ahead and laugh.」

348:t_015:6.en:
$$桂$$
「$$アサキム$$ teamed up with Advent...!」

348:t_015:7.en:
$$モーム$$
「Then maybe the one who freed him from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ was...」

348:t_015:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come, $n... Let us fight together once more.」

348:t_015:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You cannot bring yourself to trust me. ...But that is understandable.」

348:t_015:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...An opening, $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

348:t_017:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world, for the people, $$ダイターン３$$ shatters the schemes of evil!」

348:t_017:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you're not afraid of the radiance of this sun, come and get it!」

348:t_018:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So you came, $$破嵐万丈$$!」

348:t_018:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I told you, $$バルビエル$$. Now that I've defeated the $$メガノイド$$s, I'm putting everything I have into the fight against the $$サイデリアル$$.」

348:t_018:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「So $$万丈$$ was the one who took down those $$メガノイド$$s!」

348:t_018:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'd heard from $$勝平$$ that you were operating on your own, but I never figured that's what you were up to!」

348:t_018:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry I'm late joining you. But those guys were something I wanted to settle with my own hands.」

348:t_018:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Think nothing of it. If you've come, that's enough.」

348:t_018:7.en:
$$桂$$
「And at the best possible moment, too. Every time, it gives me chills...!」

348:t_018:8.en:
$n
「So that's... the dashing fellow, $$破嵐万丈$$.」

348:t_018:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「As you can see, he's a cheerful tough guy who carries the sun on his back.」

348:t_019:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry to ask this right after we meet, but can I count on your support?」

348:t_019:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I don't know the circumstances, but a shock big enough to leave you standing frozen on a battlefield doesn't go away that easily.」

348:t_020:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... Let's start over.」

348:t_021:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now it's getting interesting. That's what makes Mars Mars!」

348:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$c. $$アサキム$$ and I will cover you.」

348:t_022:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Can we trust you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

348:t_022:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Setting you aside, I can't trust $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

348:t_022:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then trust me. I have no intention of lying.」

348:t_022:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「For now, killing $$バルビエル$$ comes first. But all units, do not let your guard down.」

348:t_022:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You're all no different from me in the end. People branded with the $$烙印$$...」

348:t_022:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So it was that after all...」

348:t_022:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, but I don't have time to humor your poetry. First I'm paying $$バルビエル$$ back what I owe...!」
